s1.desc: a kitchen drawn on a plain pale grey background

s2.desc: a dining corner drawn on a plain pale grey background

spans.notes: insert of the kitchen sink piled with dirty dishes, with only a flipper reaching in (Polly's f0-16, Pax's f24-32); the pile changes by three dissolves (f16-27, f41-46, f59-69). No lead anywhere, so the whole run is one no_lead span (the dissolves sit inside a run that could never be kept)

spans.view: with a curved teal counter, a sink full of dishes, a brick range hood and a shelf of bottles behind them

beats.text: Polly points back toward the counter with one flipper while Pax stands beside her looking at her
Polly turns to Pax with a worried frown while he looks back at her
Pax closes his eyes and lays a flipper on his chest with a calm little smile while Polly watches him
Polly raises a flipper to her head in dismay while Pax keeps his eyes closed and his flipper on his chest

spans.notes: camera locked f72-102 (motion on the hood band y0.05-0.30 x0-0.30 vs f72: scale 1.0000, 0 px, cc 1.000 every 3 frames; compare 72/100: counter, hood and shelf edges black). The wider band y0.20-0.42 read up to 1.013 because the leads' heads enter it. Dissolve to the table starts at f103. No overlay, no lead depiction on the shelf or sink
dissolve from the kitchen to the dining table, f103-109 (ghost of the range hood still faint at f109; f110 clean)

spans.view: with a round cream table set with plates of food and wooden chairs

beats.text: Pax holds a plate of stacked food high on one flipper behind the table while Polly sits with her back turned, fork and spoon raised
Pax lowers the plate to his chest and holds it there, blinking once, while Polly waits in her chair with her fork and spoon up

spans.view: with a round cream table set with sushi, a sandwich and a burger, and wooden chairs

beats.text: Polly lifts a piece of sushi on her fork while Pax, across the table, winks and smiles
Polly pops the sushi into her beak with her eyes closed
Polly chews happily with her eyes closed and her fork raised while Pax keeps winking at her across the table

spans.view: with a round cream table set with stacks of pancakes and steaming mugs, and wooden chairs

beats.text: Polly holds up a steaming lilac mug shaped like a penguin face and smiles across the table at Pax, who sits with his back turned holding a coral mug
Polly closes her eyes in a happy smile, still holding up her mug, while Pax sits facing her

spans.view: with a round cream table set with bowls and plates of food, and wooden chairs

beats.text: Pax holds a spoonful of food up to Polly's beak while she looks at it
Polly takes the bite from Pax's spoon with her eyes closed
Pax pulls the spoon back while Polly chews contentedly with her eyes closed
